mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) levels compress discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 60d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase above 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL year-over-year increase exceeds 2.5% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and high unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals an economic slowdown or recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when the trigger condition is met (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% year-over-year), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) signals the end of monetary easing, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when the trigger condition is met (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100 base) signals a contraction in manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1300 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, reducing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1300 (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 4.5% (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1300 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1300 (t-test p>0.05) or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
